findings.description: The prerequisite gloss incorrectly equates docena with "десяток", which denotes ten items. Adding "(12)" does not make that Ukrainian equivalent correct.

items.reviewerAnswer: No learner task. The situation title is appropriate; docena means twelve items.
items.notes: The defect concerns the supplied prerequisite gloss; the situation metadata itself is acceptable.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Diccionario de la lengua española, entry «docena» (from memory).

findings.location: content.body.scope.noteUk: "з днями тижня прийменник не вживається (не «en lunes»)"
findings.description: This categorically prohibits prepositions with weekdays. Standard expressions such as "de lunes a viernes", "hasta el lunes" and "caer en lunes" contain prepositions. The basic el/los construction is correct, but the prohibition is too broad.
findings.suggestion: Limit the statement to simple weekday expressions answering when an event happens: "el lunes" and "los lunes", without en. Acknowledge that other constructions use prepositions.

items.reviewerAnswer: Use "el lunes" for a particular Monday and "los lunes" for recurring Mondays; "Hoy es lunes" has no article.
sources: RAE/ASALE, Nueva gramática de la lengua española, chapter 29, temporal uses of prepositions (from memory).

findings.location: task.options[id=b]: "Піти до лікаря в понеділок о п’ятій.", marked incorrect
findings.description: The distractor depends on an unstated distinction. "Лікар" can denote a medical practitioner generally, including a dentist, or be understood more narrowly as a physician contrasted with a dentist. Under the general reading, both a and b describe the required visit.
findings.suggestion: Make the distractor unambiguously incompatible with the note, for example by changing its time: "Піти до стоматолога в понеділок о десятій."

items.reviewerAnswer: a is the most precise answer; b also fits if "лікар" has its general meaning, which includes a dentist.
items.notes: The packet does not specify the narrower meaning intended for "лікар".
sources: Verdict instructions: use uncertain when the intended reading is underdetermined.
Словник української мови, entries «лікар» and «стоматолог» (from memory).

findings.description: The question asks where the celebration takes place, but the tagged hint only explains extracting dates and times. It does not support the location comprehension assessed here.
findings.suggestion: Replace the hint with guidance about finding the venue, such as "Знайди в записі місце святкування: зверни увагу на слова після en."
